translations.web: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury, and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. Many who were rich cast in much.
translations.bsb: As Jesus was sitting opposite the treasury, He watched the crowd putting money into it. And many rich people put in large amounts.
translations.kjv: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.
translations.asv: And he sat down over against the treasury, and beheld how the multitude cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.
